_comment: Versioned gate thresholds for `make eval` / `python -m citeval.eval`. Seeded from the cal30 offline baseline (results_cal30.jsonl x graded_reference_v2) WITH margin. `thresholds` are hard floors/ceilings; `baseline` is the reference point for the zero-objective-regression guard (any objective axis dropping below baseline is a breach even if it still clears the floor). After an intended, reviewed change, reseed the `baseline` block below with the fresh measured numbers via `make baseline` (== `python -m citeval.eval --print-baseline`), and bump `thresholds_version`.

scope_recall._note: Reconciled to the DEPLOYED live Opus-C3 scope verdicts: the live run flagged Bs22 (species) and Bp01 (population) as SCOPE_MISMATCH, so scope recall is 1.0 and the floor is 0.95, matching the other objective axes. (The earlier 0.80 pin reflected the lexical C3-lite stub, which the deployed system supersedes; see the one-time reconciliation in regen_results._LIVE_SCOPE_OVERRIDES.)

baseline._reseed_note: Reseeded at thresholds_version 3 (code f99d21f) after the C4 direction-reversal fix: a full cal30 re-grade cleared the confident-wrong tail (Ce11 no longer contradicted — now abstains on a genuinely borderline case; A27 now exact). graded_adjacent 0.85->1.0, qwk 0.69->0.90, recal_loo_ece 0.157->0.079; coverage 1.0->0.964 (the Ce11 abstention, still ≥0.90 floor). Objective axes unchanged (deterministic; Bp01 population-scope still via regen_results._LIVE_SCOPE_OVERRIDES).
baseline._confident_wrong_note: GENUINE errors (a_exact >= confident_wrong_tau AND ordinal-distance >= confident_wrong_min_distance): NONE. All 27 graded cases are within +/-1 of the reference. 8 confident-but-adjacent cases (A09, A10, A13, A17, Bp01, Bs07, Ch03, Ch10) remain info-only — adjacency on the 6-level scale is not an error.
